buildCommand: /bin/sh -c 'if [ -f build.sh ]; then /bin/sh build.sh; elif [ -f ../build.sh ]; then cd .. && /bin/sh build.sh; else echo build.sh not found; pwd; ls -la; exit 1; fi'
installCommand: /bin/sh -c 'if [ ! -x "$HOME/flutter/bin/flutter" ]; then git clone --depth 1 --branch stable https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"; fi'
